brief: Full-color 256px bust portrait for casimir-bell (customers.ts: Ledgerstone pawn vault). The pixel desktop shows customer faces in original color everywhere (CUSTOMER.REC, REPAIR.LOG, ticket header), and the roster shipped twelve customers on six shared faces, so each second-of-pair customer gets a face of their own. Reads as an older bald pawnbroker with a trimmed grey beard, jeweler's loupe on his forehead, waistcoat, arms folded, narrowed eyes. Same framing, palette and shading as the existing cust-01 to cust-06 set (style reference passed to the generator), dark navy ground, no text.
generation: PixelLab create_image_pro (job a7888ec7-7ce0-4751-8b40-3f8164462e5f), 1 attempt, 20 generations on the subscription allowance, style reference one of the shipped cust-0N portraits. Quantized to 64 colors with pxpost-equivalent nearest-color reduction, no resampling (native 256x256).
